policy.readBeforeContinue: Read each section below before you continue.
policy.howLead: SafarisCon is a booking marketplace. You pay in the app. We hold the money, protect provider details until you pay, and only then you get what you need to travel.
policy.howStep1Body: Public listings hide the provider's real name, phone, and exact address. You see category, area, photos, and price.
policy.howStep2Body: Email and password, then we verify your email with a one-time code. Login is password plus a code we email you.
policy.howStep3Body: Some listings confirm automatically; others wait for the provider. The provider sets how much you pay online now — at least 20% of the listing price. The rest may be due at arrival or checkout, or you may pay the full price online.
policy.howStep4Title: Pay with Mobile Money or card
policy.howStep4Body: Pay your online deposit with Mobile Money or card. Payment goes to the SafarisCon wallet, not straight to the provider. When payment succeeds, provider details and your booking code unlock.
policy.howStep5Title: Cancel only while the window is open
policy.howStep5Body: Default: until 6 hours before the service, you can cancel and get 80% back; 20% is a cancellation fee. The listing may set different hours and %. After the deadline, Cancel is hidden and the booking stays valid.
policy.howStep6Title: Show your code at the venue
policy.howStep6Body: The provider checks your booking code. Pay any remaining balance at the venue only if the listing showed a balance due after your online deposit.
policy.defaultCancelNote: Each listing shows its own cancel window and fee. Defaults are 6 hours and 20%.
accountsItems: Guests create their own account with name, email, and password.
Hotels and other providers do not self-register. SafarisCon invites them; they finish onboarding, set a password, and add payout details before they can collect payments.

After sign-up we email a 6-digit code (about 10 minutes). Login is email + password, then a one-time login code. We protect accounts with email verification and a login code, not password-only access. Passwords are stored hashed. Remember me issues a refresh token for about one day. Log out ends that session.
policy.termsLead: These terms describe the current SafarisCon product for guests and providers.
guestTerms: You must enter a valid email and complete OTP verification.
You are responsible for the accuracy of booking dates, times, guest counts, and the location fields you submit.
A booking is a contract to pay the online deposit shown and any remaining balance described on the listing. Promotions apply only if the listing still has them when you book.
Provider identity is hidden until you pay. Using the app to harvest contacts before payment is not allowed.
After payment you receive a booking code. Bring it (or the QR / receipt) to the venue.
Cancellation is only inside the window on that booking. After that, no refund through this cancel button.
SafarisCon is the marketplace and payment holder. The stay / activity is performed by the listed provider.
providerTerms: Listings go public after SafarisCon approval. You set the online deposit % on the listing (minimum 20% of the full price). SafarisCon keeps 10% of the full listing price from the customer's online deposit; guests never see that commission rate.
You must save MoMo or bank payout details before customers can pay you.
You may set cancel window hours and cancel penalty % on the listing (defaults 6 hours / 20%).
Guest money is held until the cancel window ends (or the guest cancels in time). You are not paid the moment they pay.
If the guest cancels in time, you receive your share of the cancellation fee, not the full booking.
If they do not cancel, you receive your share of the online deposit after the window, once SafarisCon confirms the payout (after 10% platform commission on the full listing price).
Completing a booking means verifying the code only — do not collect a second cash amount.
Do not put payout account numbers on the public service form.
platformTerms: We may refuse or suspend accounts that abuse OTP, payments, or listings.
Payment methods come from the live catalog. Do not assume a single telco.
Commission, default cancel window, and default penalty can differ per listing / business.
policy.privacyTitle: Privacy policy — how we handle your data
policy.privacyLead: We use your details to run accounts, bookings, receipts, and payments. We do not sell personal data.
collectRows: Account, booking contact, receipts, OTP login
Booking dates, times, guest counts, destination
To create and fulfil the booking
Required on booking requests so the provider can plan the service
Payment name, email, and MoMo number (or card checkout)
To pay the provider after the cancel window — not shown to guests
Page views and booking events. We store a hashed IP, device type, and browser — not a raw IP in the event record
notItems: We do not sell your personal data.
We do not show other customers your email, phone, or booking.
We do not put the provider's phone, exact address, or map pin on the public home page.
We do not store your card PIN or MoMo PIN. Card checkout happens on the payment provider's page. MoMo approval happens on your phone.
policy.hiddenTitle: When provider details are hidden vs unlocked
policy.hiddenBody: Before you pay, listings use an anonymous name. You may see district / area and photos. Phone, exact address, and directions stay locked. After you pay your online deposit, that booking unlocks provider identity, contact, and location for you. Other users still see the anonymous listing.
processorItems: XentriPay — collects MoMo/card payments into the SafarisCon merchant wallet and later pays providers / refunds guests.
Email delivery — OTP and booking messages.
Image hosting — listing and receipt files.
policy.controlsBody: Update profile name / phone where the account screen already allows it. Log out to end the remembered session. Providers update payout details on the payout-details page. For account deletion or a data export, contact {{email}}.
policy.securityBody: HTTPS, hashed passwords, hashed OTPs, Bearer tokens, role checks, CORS, and security headers. Private booking and pay routes require a signed-in user. You can only pay or cancel your bookings.
policy.paymentsLead: You pay an online deposit in the app (set by the provider, at least 20% of the listing price). Money is held in the SafarisCon wallet until the cancel window ends.
policy.paymentsHighlight: Deposit paid. Show your booking code at the venue. Pay any remaining balance only if the listing showed one. You can cancel until the listed deadline. If you cancel before then, you get a refund from what you paid online minus the listing's cancellation fee.
policy.pay1: Currency is RWF. Methods: Mobile Money or card.
policy.pay2: The provider sets your online deposit — at least 20% of the listing price, up to the full amount. Any remainder may be due at arrival or checkout as shown on the listing.
policy.pay3: Money is collected into the SafarisCon wallet. SafarisCon keeps 10% of the full listing price from your online deposit. The provider is not paid at that moment.
policy.pay4: A listing cannot be paid until the provider has saved valid MoMo or bank payout details.
policy.pay5: After the cancel window, SafarisCon pays the provider their share of your deposit. The platform commission (10% of the full listing price) is already taken from the deposit you paid online.
policy.afterPayBody: Your online deposit is recorded. Provider details and your booking code / QR / receipt unlock. You can cancel only until the booking's cancel deadline.
policy.cancellationBody: Only paid bookings can be cancelled for a refund. The listing sets hours before the service when cancel closes (default 6) and the percent of what you paid that you lose (default 20). Always use the numbers shown on your booking. Refunds usually arrive after a short processing time.
policy.money1: Paid online, no cancel: after the cancel deadline, SafarisCon pays the provider their share of your deposit (after 10% platform commission on the full listing price). Any balance due at the venue is between you and the provider.
policy.money2: Cancel in time: refund = paid − cancellation fee. The refund returns through the payment partner.
policy.money3: Cancel too late: no refund. The booking remains usable at the venue.
policy.atVenueBody: The provider verifies the booking code. Completing the booking does not charge anything extra.
policy.checkboxRegister: I accept the Terms of use and Privacy policy.
policy.checkboxBooking: I agree to the Terms and Payments & refunds. Provider details unlock after you pay the online deposit. Money is held until the cancel window ends.
policy.acceptBody: You must accept the Terms of use and Privacy policy before using bookings, payments, or dashboards.
